notes:
Account notes: Meadowcove is a mid-market product analytics vendor building an in-app assistant + contextual search. Primary lead is VP Product (Eva Larson) with Eng Manager (Rajat Singh) and infra lead (Lina Moreno) on calls. They started on Redwood hosted API to move quickly; POC showed good latency at their target request mix. Key ask now: move to Dedicated for predictable cost & throughput.

POC highlights (from Jonas): - workload = chat (context windows avg 1.2k tokens), reranking (top-10), embeddings for semantic search; baseline traffic for pilot ~200 rps, expected growth 3-4x in 6 months. - Observed 95th pct latency ~75ms with batching hints enabled; cost on hosted API for pilot projected ~$8k/mo.

Pricing/packaging discussion summary: Meadowcove prefers a 12-month committed plan but wants a 3-month ramp (start smaller, step up). They've sketched this internal preference: commit to 8 GPU-months for months 1-3, 12 GPU-months months 4-6, 16 GPU-months months 7-12. Burst requirement: ability to burst to +50% capacity (i.e., up to 24 GPUs) for short windows (hours) during product launches. Overage sensitivity high — they requested capped overage rate or pre-purchased burst blocks.

Redwood proposals discussed: - Option A (flat commit): 12 GPU-months committed, 20% discount vs list, burst add-on priced per GPU-hour at X with cap. - Option B (ramp): 8/12/16 commit schedule with ramp pricing (lower initial effective rate), burst pool (prepaid 40 GPU-hours/mo) + overage per GPU-hour at Y. - Option C (annual + reserved): 16 GPU-month commitment up front for deeper discount, but Meadowcove prefers ramp.

Commercial asks from customer: ROI calc linked to reduced latency and stable unit costs for forecasting; wants clear overage math (per-token vs per GPU-hour) and example billing for 2x traffic spike. Procurement asks MSA, SOC2 artefact, and Data Processing Addendum with EU residency clause.

Quotes from calls: "Need predictable bills for our finance team — spikes kill our margins" (Eva L). "If we can have a capped overage or prepaid burst product we can run canaries and launches without surprise cost" (Rajat S).

Internal notes / action items: - Send detailed pricing spreadsheet with per-GPU-hour and per-token overage scenarios (Maya, 3/11). - SE to produce POC perf breakdown by seq length and batching config (Jonas, 3/12). - Legal pack: SOC2 Type II + draft MSA + DPA (shared drive link). - Follow-up demo with infra team to validate VPC networking with Meadowcove's AWS account (scheduled 3/16).
